title: Intro to Rust
line: Ownership, borrowing, enums and Result, built and run with Cargo.

project.title: A parking garage
project.brief: Start a project with cargo new on your own. A Garage struct holds a vector of cars, park returns a Result that fails when full, and a match on an enum sets the fee per vehicle kind.
checks: cargo build finishes with no errors or warnings
Parking in a full garage prints an error and does not panic
Each vehicle kind prints its own fee

lessons.title: Start a project with Cargo
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner to make a Rust project with cargo new, open src/main.rs in VS Code, change it to print a name and a favorite number, and run it with cargo run.
lessons.passes: cargo run builds the project and prints two lines.

lessons.title: Let, mut and types
lessons.goal: Teach Rust let, mut, shadowing and the i32 and f64 types by building a phone battery tracker that starts full and drains over three apps.
lessons.passes: A full battery after drains of 15, 20 and 30 prints 35 percent left.

lessons.title: Functions and expressions
lessons.goal: Teach Rust functions with typed parameters, return types and a final expression as the return value by writing a pizza deal comparer that prices each pizza per square inch.
lessons.passes: The program prints the price per square inch of two pizzas and the better deal.

lessons.title: If, loop, while and for
lessons.goal: Teach Rust if as an expression and the loop, while and for forms by writing a Collatz counter that prints how many steps 27 takes to reach 1.
lessons.passes: Starting from 27 the program prints 111 steps.

lessons.title: Ownership and moves
lessons.goal: Teach Rust ownership and moves with String by writing a stamp function that takes a letter by value, adds a stamp and hands it back to the caller.
lessons.passes: stamp takes a String and returns a String, and the stamped letter prints.

lessons.title: Borrowing and references
lessons.goal: Teach Rust shared and mutable references by building a guest book with one function that reads it by reference and one that signs it through a mutable reference.
lessons.passes: The book prints with both new names and no function takes it by value.

lessons.title: Vectors and strings
lessons.goal: Teach Rust Vec and String, with the vec macro, push, len, iter and a for loop over a reference, by building a delivery route that totals the distances between stops.
lessons.passes: The route prints its total distance and its longest leg.

lessons.title: Structs and methods
lessons.goal: Teach Rust structs and impl blocks with self methods by building a water bottle that can drink, refill and report how much is left.
lessons.passes: Drinking 200 ml from a full 750 ml bottle prints 550 ml left.

lessons.title: Enums and match
lessons.goal: Teach Rust enums and match by building a traffic light with a next method that cycles the colors and a method that gives the wait in seconds.
lessons.passes: From red, three calls to next print green, yellow and red with their waits.

lessons.title: Option, Result and the ? operator
lessons.goal: Teach Rust Option and Result with match and the question mark operator by writing a price parser that sums prices given as text and reports the first bad one.
lessons.passes: Good prices print their sum and a bad one prints an error with no panic.
